children: South Korean defence contractor LIG Defense & Aerospace
said on Thursday it plans to take legal action including court injunction and a trial to challenge a ban against it on participating in government contract bidding.
South Korea's Defense Acquisition Program Agency announced a two-year ban against LIG on Tuesday over a corruption investigation by state prosecutors against LIG.
LIG said in a regulatory filing the ban takes effect on October 29.
